title: One-Parameter Family of Elliptic Sine-Gordon Equations
summary: We introduce a continuous one-parameter family of elliptic sine-Gordon equations (SGE) characterized by the modulus $0 \le m \le 1$ of Jacobi elliptic functions and analyze some of its properties and obtain its kink solution for various values of modulus $m$. These elliptic SGE have the novel property that while in the limit $m = 0$ they go over to the integrable sine-Gordon equation, in the $m = 1$ limit they go over to the integrable sine hyperbolic-Gordon equations (SHGE).
